title: libsufr depends on env_logger and num_cpus without using them
body:
At f085e43, `libsufr/Cargo.toml` lists `env_logger` and `num_cpus`, and nothing under `libsufr/src` uses either. The CLI declares both itself in `sufr/Cargo.toml` and uses them in `sufr/src/main.rs`.

## Proposal

Remove both from the dependencies of `libsufr`.
